findings.description: The requirement excludes latching if a different fault code is detected between the first and third detections. CON-SUP-117 specifies latching on the third detection of the same code without 60 seconds of fault-free operation since the first; it does not impose that exclusion. CON-SUP-130 also makes a code 8 report count as a detection without requiring a supervisor reset.
findings.requested_change: Resolve whether an intervening different fault-code detection breaks the sequence, then align the latch condition with the approved decision.
